mapper.insert: insert into work_order(device_id, campus_id, reporter_id, location, fault_description, status) values (#{deviceId}, #{campusId}, #{reporterId}, #{location}, #{faultDescription}, #{status})
mapper.update: update work_order set worker_id = #{workerId}, status = 'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT'
mapper.select: select w.id as workOrderId, w.campus_id as campusId, w.device_id as deviceId, d.model as deviceModel, w.fault_description as faultDescription from work_order w LEFT JOIN device d on w.device_id = d.id where w.status = 'COMPLETED' and w.id = #{workOrderId}
